newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Councils seen selling Lyttleton at NZ$1.90.
newsitem.headline: Councils seen selling Lyttleton at NZ$1.90.

text.p: New Zealand share market sources said 7.8 million shares in The Lyttleton Port Company had traded on Thursday in a block trade at NZ$1.90 per share.

The company was not initially able to confirm the deal, but brokers said the seller was a joint venture of two small local councils, the Banks Peninsula District Council and The Waimakariri District Council.
"7.8 milion shares have gone through at $1.90 today, it looks like some of the smaller council holdings selling," one source said.
Another market source said the buyer was a large institution, probably the local arm of Australia's AMP. This could not initially be confirmed.
